title: CIA Associations — Co-presence & Relationship Network
rule: An association records a sourced relation such as co-presence, direct interaction, explicit relationship language or project-symbolic linkage. Co-presence alone does not prove friendship, alliance, motive, conflict or wrongdoing.

recovery_targets: Replace Chronicle-only co-presence with raw chat/VOD evidence where available.
Add direction and relation type only when a source supports it.
Record rupture/repair transitions as separate dated bond states rather than overwriting the earlier relationship.

association_types.co_presence: Two characters occur in the same dated scene.
association_types.direct_interaction: A source preserves an exchange or action between characters.
association_types.explicit_relationship: A source explicitly describes a relationship; retain wording and scope.
association_types.project_symbolic: A literary or Potatoverse role connects characters; never silently convert this to biography.
